meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: 你要求规划功能、任务或多步骤实现时，Claude会先搜索并阅读相关文档，然后产出分阶段执行计划：每阶段包含具体做法、文档引用、验证清单和应避免的反模式，最后统一验证。
howto.when: 当你要求规划一个功能、任务或多步骤实现时触发，尤其在用 do 执行之前。

say.text: 帮我为这个新功能制定一个分阶段实施计划。
say.note: Claude会先查文档再输出计划。

say.text: 先做文档发现，再按阶段列出任务和验证步骤。
say.note: 会得到带文档引用和检查清单的计划。

say.text: 在开始写代码前，先给我一个包含反模式防护的计划。
say.note: 计划会注明哪些API不能用。

howto.what_en: Claude first does documentation discovery, then outputs a phased implementation plan: each phase lists concrete tasks, doc references, verification checklist, and anti-patterns to avoid, ending with a verification phase.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, especially before executing with do.

say_en.text: Create a phased implementation plan for this new feature.
say_en.note: Claude will research docs first, then output the plan.

say_en.text: Do doc discovery first, then list tasks and verification per phase.
say_en.note: You'll get a plan with doc references and checklists.

say_en.text: Before coding, give me a plan with anti-pattern guards.
say_en.note: It will note which APIs not to use.
